svg.text: The CSVs are for reports. Save game is the whole game, loadable back.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ending asks first, parks the clock at 00:00 of the last period and marks the game final — that is what settles the last seconds of the minutes.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The game lives in this browser alone: clearing the site data erases it. Save before you clear anything, and before you hand the tablet back.
